config.label: Identify your own client
config.description: Identify your own client. This project's identifier stays appended, so Wikimedia can always reach a human.

config.label: Minimum milliseconds between requests
config.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 1000, floor 500, ceiling 60000.

config.label: Deadline for one request, in milliseconds
config.description: Deadline for one request, in milliseconds. Default 20000.

config.label: Retries on a busy or rate-limited gateway
config.description: Retries on a busy or rate-limited gateway. Default 3.

config.label: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds
config.description: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds. Default 900000. Set 0 to turn it off.

config.label: silent, error, info or debug
config.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
